featured_reviews.name: Rafik Lulania
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Memorable and Amazing Europe Tour with LPO Holidays was nothing less than a dream come true.

Travelling across Europe for 16 days with LPO Holidays has been the experience of a lifetime — and the credit goes to our LPO Tour Manager NASIR BHAI, the heart and backbone of this journey.
Always patient, always smiling, and always 10 steps ahead… he made sure not a single moment felt mismanaged. His stories, knowledge, and care turned this tour into memories we will cherish forever.

We, a group of 45 members from Palghar, had dreamt for years of exploring Europe — and LPO Holidays made it happen, that too at a fantastic price.
Special thanks to owner Mr. Sushil Sir, who personally came to Palghar, explained everything with clarity, and — most importantly — delivered exactly what he promised.

Perfect arrangements from start to end: luxurious coach, comfortable hotels, fabulous meals (veg, non-veg, Jain), and even unexpected treats like pani puri, pav bhaji, jalebi, mutton, fish, and all European delicacies from pizzas to black forest cake.
Guide Mr. Nasir Shaikh, with 27 years of experience, was exceptional — knowledgeable, humble, and always helpful.
Our coach captain Mr. Andriez kept us safe and comfortable with smooth driving.

We explored Italy, Austria, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, France, and Switzerland — from Rome, Pisa, Venice, Frankfurt, Hallstatt, Brussels, Paris to 4 magical days in Switzerland.
The cruise rides in Venice and Paris were unforgettable.

Even during a medical emergency when Mrs. Mangala Jirapure suffered a minor stroke, LPO and Nasir bhai handled the situation like true professionals.
Nasir bhai rushed with her in the ambulance, coordinated with hospital and LPO team, and still ensured the rest of the group had a smooth tour.
This dedication is rare, and we are deeply grateful.

Everything — literally everything — about the tour was perfect.

And then came the only issue — a flight delay at Kuwait Airport.

Last day we reached Milan to fly Mumbai via Kuwait Airways. Due to dense fog and Kuwait Airways’ own operational problems, we were stuck in Kuwait Airport for 20 hours.

And let’s be very clear here —
Fog aur airline delay ka LPO se koi rishta nahi hota.
Unhe blame karna utna hi unreasonable hai jitna mausam ko complaint email bhejna.

Hum sabne poora Europe tour enjoy kiya — hotels top, food top, sightseeing top, management top.
LPO ne apni taraf se 100% diya.

Isliye feedback TOUR ke hisaab se hi dunga.

Airline ka mess LPO ke khate me daalna not just unfair — it’s misplaced and honestly, thoda ajeeb lagta hai.

Airline claim ka follow-up alag se chal raha hai, but uski wajah se poori tour performance ko question karna sahi baat nahi.

We all enjoyed the entire trip with family, took all the benefits, but now suddenly blaming LPO for airline fog delay… honestly, it says more about US than about LPO.

Thank you LPO Holidays, Sushil Ji, Nasir Bhai, Seema, Amit and the entire team for turning our European dream into reality — with luxury, care, and perfection.

Looking forward to many more international trips with LPO.

Warm regards,
Shamim Lulania
